evidence.zh: 绿度比30天前下降了21%，比去年同期下降了32%。
evidence.en: Greenness is down 21 percent from 30 days ago and 32 percent from the same time last year.

evidence.zh: 近30天降雨是21.6毫米，去年同期是261.8毫米。
evidence.en: Rainfall over the last 30 days was 21.6 millimeters, compared with 261.8 millimeters last year.

evidence.zh: 现在根层湿度是0.71，去年同期是0.92。
evidence.en: Root-zone wetness is 0.71 now, compared with 0.92 at the same time last year.
There were 3 heat days in the last 30 days.

summary.zh: 到2022年8月25日，这块中稻又缺水，又在受热。绿度比30天前少了21%，比去年同期少了32%。近30天只下了21.6毫米雨，还过了3个高温日。
summary.en: As of August 25, 2022, this mid-season rice is short of water and under heat stress. Greenness is 21 percent lower than 30 days ago and 32 percent lower than the same time last year. Only 21.6 millimeters of rain fell in the last 30 days, and there were 3 heat days.

text.zh: 雨少，别等到中稻叶子打卷再灌。清晨或傍晚先看田，再补水，让根层保持湿润。
text.en: Do not wait until mid-season rice leaves roll before you irrigate. Check the field in the early morning or evening, then water so the root zone stays moist.

text.zh: 先给正在抽穗扬花的中稻田补水。这个时候缺水最伤这些田，其他田往后排。
text.en: Water the mid-season rice fields that are flowering first. A dry spell hurts those fields most right now, so leave the other fields for later.

text.zh: 遇到高温日，在凉快的早晨或傍晚给叶面喷清水，帮中稻缓一缓。不要自己加药剂，也不要自己定用量。
text.en: On a heat day, spray clean water on the leaves in the cool morning or evening to ease the heat on mid-season rice. Do not add a chemical product or choose a dose yourself.

caveats.zh: 行动前先跟当地农技站确认。没有人到田里看过，这只是远程判断。
caveats.en: Confirm with your local agricultural extension station (农技站) before acting. Nobody visited the field; this is only a remote reading.
